description: Core defaults, plus exactly what the custom title bar needs on the main window: minimize, maximize/restore, close, drag and window theme. No filesystem, shell, dialog or opener access (docs/MIGRATION_PLAN.md section 8). `remote.urls` lets the page served by the Stuby server (the one embedded in the desktop app on a loopback port, or the dev server at :8080) call these window commands; any other origin gets nothing.
